translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yaak'oobi Laabaappe Bak'atiide Beedda
Yaak'oobi Laabaana naanay barena, «Yaak'oobi nu aawuwaa ubbaa aki diggeedda; ha duretaa ubbaa nu aawuwaappe demmeedda» giyaawaa siseedda.
Yaak'oobi Laabaana som"i barew kasewaa mala gidennawaa be'eedda.
He wode Med'inaa Goday Yaak'ooba, «Neeni ne aawotuwaa gadiyaa, ne dabbotuwaakko guyye simma; taani neenana gidana» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi Raaheelonne Liyo bare wudii de'iyaa sa'aa dembbaa yaana mala kiittiide s'eesisseedda.
I unttuntta, «Hinttenttu aawuwaa som"i taw kasewaa mala gidennawaa taani be'ay; shin ta aawuwaa S'oossay taananna de'ee.
Taani ta wolk'k'aa ubbaan hinttenttu aawuu ootseeddawaa hinttenttu eriita;
shin hinttenttu aawuu taana c'immiidde, ta dirgguwaa tammu gede laammeedda. Gidooppenne S'oossay taana I k'ohenaadan diggeedda.
I, ‹Punc'c'aretuu ne dirgguwaa gidana› giina, wudii ubbay punc'c'ariyaa yeleedda; k'ay I, ‹shachchatuu ne dirgguwaa gidana› giina, wudii ubbay shachchaa yeleedda.
S'oossay hawaadan hinttenttu aawuwaa mehiyaa wotsi akkiidde taw immeedda.
«Mehetuu kahiyaa aginaan, taani itti akumuwaa akumetaad; he akumuwaan taani s'eelliyaa wode, wudiyaa birassiyaa deeshsha koletuu danc'c'aa, punc'c'arenne gazza.
S'oossaa kiitanchchay akumuwaan taana, ‹Yaak'ooba› yaageedda; taani, abee yaagaadde koyaad.
Taana I, d'ok'k'u gaade wudiyaa s'aaliyaa deeshshaa koliyaa ubbaa shachchaa, punc'c'ariyaanne gazzaa be'a; ayaw gooppe, Laabi ne bolla ootsiyaawaa ubbaa taani be'aaddi.
Neeni esseedda shuchchaa okkaadde, taw shiik'etteedda Beeteele S'oossay taana ha"i dendda; ha biittaappe kesa; guyye ne yeletaa gadiyaa simma yaageedda» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Raaheelanne Liya hawaadan yaagiide zaareeddino; «Nu aawuwaappe nuuna gakkanabay ayee?
I nuuna allagaadan s'eellee gidennee? I nuuna zal"i akkeedda; zal"iidde akkeeddawaakka mi d'aysseedda.
S'oossay nu aawuwaappe wotsi akkeedda mas'uu ubbay tumukka nuwaanne nu naanaawaa. Hewaa diraw s'oossay new odeeddawaa ubbaa ootsa» yaageeddino.

Yaak'oobi Kanaane gadiyaan de'iyaa bare aawuwaa Yisaak'akko baanaw denddeedda; I bare naanaanne bare machatuwaa gaaluwaa togisseedda; wudiyaa ubbaa bareppe sintsanna laaggiide, Masp'p'es'oomiyaan de'iidde I shiishsheedda mas'uwaa ubbaa akkiidde beedda.
Laabi bare dorssatuwaa isikiyaa k'ans's'anaw bidigeeddoshin, Raaheela bare aawuwaa soo misiletuwaa wuu'aaddu.
K'ay Yaak'oobi Sooriyaa Laabaanaw bare bak'atiyaawaa odenaan c'immeedda.
I barew de'iyaawaa ubbaa akkiidde bak'ateedda; Efiraas'iisa Shaafaa pinniide, Gala'aade giyaa gezziyaakko simmiide beedda.
Laabi Yaak'ooba Kaalleedda
Heezzentsa gallassan, Laabi Yaak'oobi bak'ati bi kichcheeddawaa siseedda.
Bare dabbotuwaa barenana akkiidde, laappun gallassaa ogiyaa Yaak'ooba geeduwaa kaalliidde, Gala'aade gezziyaan Aa gakkeedda.
He wode S'oossay k'amma Sooriyaa Laabaanakko akumuwaan yiide Aa, «Neeni Yaak'ooba bolla iita gidina, lo"a gidina, ayinne haasayennaadan neena era!» yaageedda.
Laabi gakkiyaa wode, Yaak'oobi Gala'aade gezziyaan dunkkaaniide utteedda; k'ay Laabinne Aa dabbotuu yan dunkkaaneeddino.
Hewaappe guyye Laabi Yaak'ooba, «Neeni hawaadan ayaw ootsaaddii? Neeni taana c'immaade, ta mac'c'a naanaa olan omoodetteeddawaadan laaggaade kessaadda.
Neeni ayaw k'osuwaan taappe kessa akkaade, taana c'immaadii? Taani neena nashechchaaninne yetsaan, karabuwaaninne diitsaan moyzzana mala taw ayaw odabeykkii?
Neeni haray atto, ta naanaa naanaanne ta mac'c'a naanaa taani yera akkena mala diggaadda. Neeni eeyyabaa ootsaadda.
Taani neena genanaw taw wolk'k'ay de'ee; shin ne aawuwaa S'oossay zino k'amma taana, ‹Yaak'ooba bolla iita gidina, lo"a gidina, ayinne haasayennaadan neena era!› yaagiide taw odeedda.
Ha"i gidooppenne, neeni ne aawuwaa soo baanaw loytsa laamoteedda diraw kesaadda. Shin ta soo misiletuwaa neeni ayaw wuu'aadii?» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi Laabaana, «Neeni ne naanaa taappe wolk'k'an wotsa akkaninttonne gaade k'oppeedda dirawunne yayyeedda diraw, hawaadan ootsaad.

Shin ne soo misiletuwaa oyk'k'eedda asaa oonanne neeni demmooppe, he uray siifetto! Newaa gideeddawe ta matan beettintto, nu dabbatuwaa sintsan koya; newaa gidooppe akka» yaageedda; ayaw gooppe, Yaak'oobi Raaheela he soo misiletuwaa wuu'eeddawaa eribeenna.

Hewaa diraw Laabi Yaak'ooba dunkkaaniyaa giddo, Liya dunkkaaniyaa giddon laa"u k'oomatuwaa dunkkaaniyaa giddo geleedda; shin ayinne demmibeenna. Liya dunkkaaniyaappe kesiide, Raaheeli dunkkaaniyaa geleedda.
Raaheela soo misiletuwaa akkaade, gaaluwaa kooraa garssan k'osaade, Aa bolla uttaaddu. Laabi dunkkaaniyaan de'iyaawaa ubbaa bulluuk'k'i koyeedda; shin ayinne demmibeenna.
Raaheela bare aawuwaa, «Ta godaw, taana hank'k'etsoppa; taani new ek'k'ana danddaykke; taw piilay yi utteedda» yaagaaddu. I koyeedda; shin soo misiletuwaa demmibeenna.
Yaak'oobi Laabaana hank'k'ettiide wok'k'aseedda; Yaak'oobi Laabaana, «Taani ayaa bayzaadittaa? Hawaa neeni taana kaallanaw, taani ootseedda nagaray ayee?
Ha"i neeni ta miishshaa ubbaa bulluk'k'aadde koyaadda; ne soo miishshaappe ayaa demmaad? Unttunttu nu laa"uwaa gidduwaan pirddana mala, ta dabbatuwaa sintsaaninne ne dabbatuwaa sintsaan hawaan wotsa.
«Taani neenana laatamu laytsaa kumentsaa de'aad; ne dorssaykka ne deeshshaykka boshetibeenna; woy ne wudiyaappe s'abootiyaa mabeykke.
Do'ay mentseeddawaanne new ahabeyikke; shin hewaa taanan paydaad. Gallassi wuu'etteeddawaa woy k'amma wuu'etteeddawaa taana c'igissaadda.
Gallassaa suuluu, k'amma meeguu taana k'oheedda; gem"ishuu taappe d'ayeedda.

Taani hawaadan ne soon laatamu laytsaa de'aad; tammanne oyddu laytsaa ne laa"u mac'c'a naanaa dirawunne usuppun laytsaa ne wudiyaa diraw new ootsaadde de'aad; shin neeni ta dirgguwaa tammu gede laammaadda.

Ta aawuwaa S'oossay, Abrahaame S'oossay, Yisaak'i yayyeeddawe taananna gidibeennawaa gidintto, sid'e baynnan neeni taana mela kushe kessa yeddaadda; shin S'oossay ta tuggaanne ta kushiyaa oosuwaa be'iide, zino k'amma neena seereedda» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobinne Laabi C'aak'k'eteedda C'aak'uwaa

Laabi Yaak'ooba, «Machatuu ta mac'c'a naanaa; naanaykka ta naanaa; wudiikka ta wudiyaa; neeni be'iyaa ubbay tawaa. Hachche ha mac'c'a naanaa tawanttu bollanne unttunttu yeleedda naanaa bolla ayaa ootsanaw danddayayitaa?
Ha"i haaya; neeninne taani c'aak'uwaa c'aak'k'etoytte; hewe neeppenne taappe gidduwaan markka gido» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw Yaak'oobi itti shuchchaa akkiidde tuussaadan esseedda.
I bare dabbotuwaa, «Shuchchaa shiishshite» yaageedda; unttunttu shuchchaa shiishshiide keeleeddinno; he keelaa lank'k'iyaan meeddino.
Laabi he keelaa, Yigaari-Sahaaduta
giide suntseedda; k'ay Yaak'oobi Aa C'imeedda giide suntseedda.
Laabi, «Ha keelay neeppenne taappe gidduwaan hachche markka» yaageedda. Hewaa diraw Aa suntsay C'imeedda geetetteedda.
K'ay I he shuchchaa tuussaa Mis'ip'p'a
giide suntseedda; ayaw gooppe, Laabi, «Nuuni ittuu ittuwaappe haakkiide de'iyaa wode, Med'inaa Goday ne gidduwaaninne ta gidduwaan gidiide naago.

Neeni ta mac'c'a naanaa naak'k'ooppe, woy neeni ta mac'c'a naanaa bolla hara machatuwaa akkooppe, nuunana ha"i ooninne baynnawaa gidooppenne ne gidduwaaninne ta gidduwaan S'oossay markka gidiyaawaa hassaya» yaageedda.
Laabi k'aykka Yaak'ooba, «Keeleteedda shuchchay hawesh; k'ay taani ne gidduwaaninne ta gidduwaan esseedda shuchchaa tuussay hawesh.
Taani ha keelaappe neena genanaw neekko aad'd'enaaddan, neenikka taana genanaw ha keelaappenne ha shuchchaa tuussaappe aad'd'enaaddan, ha keelaynne ha shuchchaa tuussay markka.
Abrahaame S'oossay, Naakoora S'oossay, unttunttu aawuwaa S'oossay, nu gidduwaan I pirddo» yaageedda. Yaak'oobi bare aawuu Yisaak'i Yayyeeddawaa suntsaan c'aak'k'eedda.
Yaak'oobi deriyaa bollan yarshshuwaa yarshsheedda; bare dabbotuwaakka k'umaa maanaw s'eeseedda. Unttunttu miide deriyaa bollan ak'eedino.
Wonttetsa gallassi guuran Laabi denddiide, bare naanaa naanaanne bare mac'c'a naanaa yereedda; k'ay unttuntta anjjeedda. Bare soo simmeedda.

footnotes.text: Yigaari-Sahaaduta: Ha suntsaa biletsay Aramayssis's'e k'aalan, «Markkatetsaa keelaa» giyaawaa.
Mis'ip'p'a: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Naagiyaa sa'aa» giyaawaa.
